{{nihongo|'''Samakumine Shrine'''|佐麻久嶺神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Mutsu Province]].

'''Samakumine Shrine''' (さまくみねじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} located in {{ill|Fukushima Prefecture|Q71707|qid=Q71707}}, {{ill|Iwaki, Fukushima|ar|لواكي (فوكوشيما)|arz|لواكى|azb|ایواکی، فوکوشیما|bg|Иваки|ca|Iwaki|ce|Иваки (Фукусима)|ceb|Iwaki-shi|de|Iwaki|eo|Iwaki|es|Iwaki (Fukushima)|eu|Iwaki (Fukushima)|fa|ایواکی، فوکوشیما|fi|Iwaki|fr|Iwaki|ga|Iwaki|gl|Iwaki|hu|Ivaki (Fukusima)|hy|Իվակի|id|Iwaki, Fukushima|is|Iwaki|it|Iwaki|ja|いわき市|kk|Иваки|ko|이와키시|lt|Ivakis|mg|Iwaki|mzn|ایواکی، فوکوشیما|nl|Iwaki (Fukushima)|no|Iwaki|pl|Iwaki|pt|Iwaki|ro|Iwaki|ru|Иваки (город)|sh|Ivaki|simple|Iwaki, Fukushima|sr|Иваки|sv|Iwaki|tg|Иваки|th|อิวากิ (จังหวัดฟูกูชิมะ)|tl|Iwaki, Fukushima|tr|Iwaki, Fukuşima|tt|Иваки (Фукусима)|uk|Івакі (Фукусіма)|ur|ایواکی، فوکوشیما|uz|Ivaki(Iwaki), Fukushima|vi|Iwaki, Fukushima|war|Iwaki, Fukushima|za|Banjsingz Si|zh|磐城市|zh_classical|磐城市|zh_min_nan|Iwaki-chhī|zh_yue|磐城|qid=Q274384}}, {{ill|Taira Nakayama|ja|平中山|qid=Q128846768}}. It is listed as a minor shrine in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|abstract|Q11064932|fr|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|simple|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|zh|延喜式神名帳|qid=Q11064932}} and was formerly ranked as a gōsha under the {{ill|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|Q712534|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines}}.

=== History ===
According to shrine tradition, it was founded in the first year of {{ill|Keiun|ar|فترة كيون|de|Keiun|es|Keiun|fa|کیوئون|fr|Ère Keiun|ia|Keiun|id|Keiun|ja|慶雲|ko|게이운|ru|Кэйун|simple|Keiun|sr|Кеиун|th|เคอุง|tr|Keiun|uk|Кей'ун|zh|慶雲 (日本)|zh_yue|慶雲 (日本)|qid=Q428753}} ({{ill|704|Q23503|qid=Q23503}}).

In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|abstract|Q11064932|fr|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|simple|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|zh|延喜式神名帳|qid=Q11064932}}, it is listed as one of seven shrines in {{ill|Mutsu Province|ca|Província de Mutsu|cs|Provincie Mucu|de|Provinz Mutsu|es|Provincia de Mutsu|fa|ولایت موتسو|fi|Mutsun provinssi|fr|Province de Mutsu|gl|Provincia de Mutsu|id|Provinsi Mutsu|it|Mutsu (provincia)|ja|陸奥国|ko|무쓰국|lt|Mucu žemė|nl|Mutsu (provincie)|pt|Província de Mutsu|ru|Муцу (провинция)|simple|Mutsu Province|sk|Mucu (provincia)|sr|Провинција Муцу|tr|Mutsu (vilayet)|uk|Муцу (провінція)|zh|陸奧國|zh_classical|陸奧國|zh_min_nan|Mutu-kok|zh_yue|陸奧國|qid=Q907389}}, {{ill|Iwaki district|ja|石城郡|qid=Q11585428|lt=Iwaki District}}, and was classified as a minor shrine. During the {{ill|Edo period|Q184963|qid=Q184963}}, it received patronage from the {{ill|Iwakitaira Domain|Q843782|qid=Q843782}}. When it was destroyed by lightning in the second year of {{ill|Tenna|Q1145289|qid=Q1145289|lt=Tenna}} ({{ill|1682|Q7648|qid=Q7648}}), the shrine buildings were rebuilt the following year by the domain lord {{ill|Naitō Yoshimune|Q8514975|qid=Q8514975|lt=Naitō Yoshiyasu}}, and thereafter successive lords carried out further repairs and renovations.

In the ninth year of {{ill|Meiji era|Q3125096|qid=Q3125096}} ({{ill|1876|Q7766|qid=Q7766}}), it was officially designated as a gōsha.
